title: Export & import
intro: Move a whole site between NodePress installs: choice lists, components, content types and every entry, in every language and status, in one JSON file.
mediaNote: Media files aren't included. Entries keep their image links, which keep working while the files stay on R2, S3, ImageKit or the old server.
exportText: Download the whole site as one JSON file. It includes drafts, so keep it private.
importText: Choose a site export. Content types are matched by name and entries by slug and language, and relations between entries keep working.
invalidFile: This isn't a NodePress site export
overwriteHint: Off: content types and entries that already exist here are kept as they are.
cliHint: For large sites, use the CLI: npx nodepress site:export and npx nodepress site:import.
entriesLine: Entries: {toCreate} new, {toUpdate} to update, {toRestore} restored from the trash, {toSkip} kept as they are
relinked: {count, plural, one {# entry has} other {# entries have}} a different id on this site; relations to them are updated.
problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}: nothing is imported until the file is fixed
